data.rationale: Cases: FCRM-2026-0151. Nearest: FFIEC-TPPP-04 (n/a), FCRM42-3.1 (n/a), TP71-2.3 (n/a), OFAC-1.2 (n/a). Owner standard: INT-TP-7.1, the internal third-party standard, which already addresses agent networks in general. Cash-pickup agents handle physical payouts for the case, and no clause in the corpus addresses them specifically.
data.scope_suggestion: Suggested scope (not policy): Cover AML risk arrangements for cash-pickup agent networks used to pay out cross-border transfers, including how such agents are identified and overseen.
